outcomes.label: Died before maturity
outcomes.title: Established, then died of water stress before maturity (yield so far counted)

outcomes.label: Failed to establish
outcomes.title: Died before its canopy reached 5 %: a false start, the seedlings dried out

outcomes.label: Too late to mature
outcomes.title: Sown too late to reach maturity by 31 Mar (counted as no yield)

outcomes.label: No sowing opportunity
outcomes.title: No onset by the rule's search end, 15 Jan (counted as no yield)

caveats: Experimental: the crop model is not calibrated for these sites or varieties, and the forecast runs have not been verified for crop outcomes.
Varieties are maturity classes built from AquaCrop's default crop parameters, not calibrated cultivars.
Yields are water-limited: no nutrient stress, pests or management losses, AquaCrop default plant density; they are an upper bound for smallholder fields.
Temperature and ET0 after the last ERA5-Land day are the 1993–2016 day-of-year climatology; March rain is a climatological continuation (observed CHIRPS of a calibration year).
Soil is the 0.25° SoilGrids average of the site's grid cell, not a field measurement.
Deterministic weather models are the same forecast in every member: their spread comes from SEAS5 only.
